Name: Pekod
ModernLocation: Region at the mouth of Nahr al Kassarah
Description: A people and region named in Jeremiah's oracle against Babylon, 'go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the inhabitants of Pekod,' and in Ezekiel's allegory among the Babylonians and Chaldeans.
BiblicalSignificance: Pekod is a name of judgment in two prophets: a people counted among Babylon's own, and then counted among its victims.
